summary: The main article describes a photoredox-enabled remote radical group migration for synthesizing 1,7-dicarbonyl compounds using diazoalkanes. It includes optimization tables, substrate scope schemes for alkenes and diazoalkanes, and mechanistic studies including radical trapping and Stern-Volmer quenching.
